column1: # A lottery on the stranger-introduction coin, like `town-talk`.

# makes one fresh host-clock read, assigns the transformed value as the shared
# random-generator state, and immediately flips a fair coin. On one outcome
# the conversation simply proceeds to the keyword prompt with nothing said
# after the description. On the other the NPC introduces itself". The two
# sides never share a host clock, so the `"I am called <name>"` row is the
# coin's and not the engine's, and a run that disagrees on it must be re-run.
